notes.title: A ”Train jp" renewed & user survey started
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

We are pleased to announce the complete renewal of "A Train jp" ( https://www.atrain.jp/ ), the official portal site for the urban development railroad simulation games "A-Train" series.

The site is like a terminal station where information on "A-Train" related products and projects can be found more easily, and where fun videos created by users can be gathered.

[b]- About the renewed "A-Train jp" -[/b]

"A-Train jp" ( https://www.atrain.jp/ ), the official portal site for the "A-Train" series, is a portal site where information on the "A-Train" series is gathered. The site has recently undergone a complete renewal. We have improved the ease of use and gathering of information so that newcomers can quickly access the information they want and fans will want to visit the site again and again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/debe2c3376552d44962ae4576d3ccc5f67b1ae9a.png[/img]

[u]It is now easier to find products! [/u]

Added category search by platform to the "Products" page. It is now easier to find A-Train that can be played on your platform. Also, we have enhanced the product description so that you can compare products without having to jump to the official website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/11b818734373c4af922ff8fa2f9accecec0df693.png[/img]

[u]A place where users' videos gathered! [/u]

Added search by product title and play style such as "Car Window" and "Urban Development" to the "Minna no Machi Video Plaza" page. It is now easier to find videos of your choice.

In conjunction with this change, we have updated the "Video Submission Guidelines" that have already been published.

Your videos may be featured on this page!? We are looking forward to your video submissions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/cbfc2d0379670e59c7aef53cb82b40b6221d7ad5.png[/img]

[u]Enhancement of image materials and postings[/u]

We have added image materials for "A-Train 9" and "A-Train Exp." to the "Video Submission Guidelines," as well as an "Illustration Museum" and a "Wallpaper Corner" in the "Special Events" section.

You can view and download images used in the game and images that have been posted on SNS and other sites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/0dc73ac76f8afd6d3a19a5f591a9e5b6315d80f9.png[/img]

[u]User Survey Started[/u]

In conjunction with the renewal, we have started a "User Questionnaire". We would like to ask all "A-Train" users to answer the questionnaire so that we can use it as a reference for future product development and promotions.
(until October 31, 2023).

We will continue to provide information on "A-Train" through this website, and we appreciate your patronage.

[b]- About the "A-Train" series -[/b]

The "A-Train" series is an urban development railroad company management simulation game, the first of which was released by Art Dink in 1985.

Players take on the role of the president of a railroad company and work to realize an ideal city through urban development, railroad operation, and company management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/5e043f62b67e66f80337ef7f39f4389eb1a0499b.png[/img]

The "A-Train" series is highly creative and satisfies the unique goals and desires of each player. 
Feel the joy of developing a railroad line where the railroad and the city are in harmony.
Examine the best diagram for the city's demand and find the optimal solution
Grow the company with skillful management skills and lead it to accomplish large-scale projects
Savor to your heart's content the expansion and development of the city's possibilities
--The variety of the company's appeal has not faded, and it continues to be loved by many people.

We offer two types of products, "Realistic" and "Hakoniwa", depending on the features and contents.
Please enjoy the world of "A-Train" to your heart's content with the system of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/563d50c585634a7409a4c3999f2c914577a25572.png[/img]

notes.title: ”Scenario Contest" is on now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/775a33a8e44b7187cb3e3bed21bccacfd1626fa6.png[/img]

[b]*All scenarios need to be submitted in Japanese and by users who live in Japan*[/b]

The best part of tourism planning is developing a destination by leveraging the power of the railroad to take advantage of the region's attractions. There will be as many stories of towns overcoming problems and growing as there are tourist destinations to aim for.

In "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism," you can not only develop an existing town but also create the story of the town from scratch, from the topography that forms the foundation of the town to the thoughts of the people involved in its development.

In this scenario contest, we are looking for scenarios with the theme of "a sightseeing spot with a problem" that is filled with the possibilities of such a story.

We are looking forward to receiving your powerful scenarios filled with your passion for urban development!

[h3]Submission Period[/h3]
Monday, March 13, 2023 - Wednesday, May 31, 2023 (JST)
Entries received after the end of the application period will not be considered.

[h3]Application Theme[/h3]
"Tourist Attraction with a Problem."
Just as the attractions of unexplored hot spring towns and remote islands surrounded by nature...... vary from tourist destination to tourist destination, the types of problems they face also vary.
In this contest, we are calling for scenarios with potential for development based on the theme of "tourist attractions with problems."

[h3]Prize Money[/h3]
50,000 yen (6 winners)
The amount may be increased or decreased depending on the entries.

[h3]Entry Rules[/h3]
For more information, please check the contest website.
https://www.atrain.jp/at-scenario/

notes.title: A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism - Build 34350.965 update
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

We would like to thank everyone's for their support of "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism."

We hope you are enjoying building up your touring plan so far. We have just released the latest version, "Build 30257.629," which contains a  few bug fixes as usual. In addition, we are sorry for not being able to provide the new DLC to players outside of Japan due to the licensing issues, but you can still enjoy the following new features that we implemented for the DLC. 

The updates are as follows.

[h3]Camera[/h3]
・Tracking Camera
　Added "Bullet Train" and "Private Automobiles" as targets.
※"Private automobiles" can be tracked by selecting a private automobile on the road.

・Layer Display
　Added a shortcut to change the layer view.
　It can be used on the screen where the "Whole map" icon is displayed.

【Controller Controls】
　X button + directional pad up: Moves up one level.
　X button + Directional pad down: Lower level by one
　X button + Directional pad left: Displays the current layer/all layers (to switch over).
　X button + Directional pad right: Displays current level/all levels (to switch over).

【Keyboard Controls】
　Shift + move up key: Moves up one level.
　Shift + move down key: Moves down one level.
　Shift + move left : Displays the current layer/all layers (to switch over).
　Shift + move key right : Displays the current layer/all layers (to switch over).

【Mouse operation】
　Shift + wheel up : Moves up one level.
　Shift + wheel down : Moves down one level.
　Shift + wheel pressed in : Displays the current layer/all layers (to switch over).

[h3][Automobile][/h3]
[Operating Schedule]
　Add "Empty Lane" to "Parking Location."

[h3][Plan][/h3]
[Changes]
・Bus Development
　Stickers on the front and back of the bus are now separated and can be applied separately.

[h3][Construction][/h3]
・"Auto-Develop Pausing" has been added to "Regional Settings".
　You can choose to have the city develop automatically for all regions or for each region.
　If stopped, the city will not automatically develop during constructions.

[h3][System][/h3]
・"Anti-aliasing" was added to "Graphics".
・Added "Close Menu Tracking Camera" in "Other Settings".
・You can now set "Flip camera up/down" and "Flip camera left/right" separately for Free view and Isometric view in "Other Settings".

[h3][Help][/h3]
・Additional content for "Vistas Abound" has been added.

[h3][Miscellaneous][/h3]
※Please note that plans created before "Build 34350.965" will no longer appear as bonus plans in saved data created with "Build 34350.965".

[h3][Bug fixes][/h3]
[Train]
・Fixed a bug when "Change Formation" and "Replace" were performed consecutively, the display of cars became incorrect.
・Fixed a bug where Freight Trains can be purchased as a single-car formation.

[Automobiles]
・Fixed a bug in which the Y button icon would be displayed at the transit point other than the stops on a operating route.
・Fixed a bug where when designating a garage for a stop with the parking location set to "Empty Lane", the automobile exiting the garage would make an emergency stop.

[Subsidiary]
・Fixed a bug in which Parking Lot 1 (both attached and independent) could not be constructed under the elevated train lines and roads at the height of 2F.
・Fixed a bug in which the impact of "Cargo Handling Area 1" and "Freight Handling Area 2" on surrounding subsidiaries was incorrect.
※If "Cargo Handling Area 1" and "Freight Handling Area 2" are already located on the map, the impact will be changed to the correct one.
・Fixed a bug in which the description of "Low-Rise Buildings 16" was incorrect.

[Tourism]
・Fixed a bug where when two or more tourist destinations are removed at the same time, the information of one of them would remain in the tourist information.
・Fixed a bug in which tourists would illegally go back and forth between stations on a tourist route that includes the bullet train.

[Plan]
・Fixed a bug in which a trade port could be built at the edge of the map.

[Other]
・Fixed a bug in which the player was unable to unlock achievements under certain circumstances.
・Fixed a bug in which the player was unable to unlock the "Metropolis" achievement.
・Minor problems that have been corrected in other console versions have now also been fixed here.

We are keen to provide the best "A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism" to you, so please let us know if you have any other feedback.

notes.notes:

The new DLC "A-Train Vistas Abound" is set to be released on March 3rd (JST), but unfortunately for our users outside of Japan, there is some bad news.

Thank you for playing this game, and we are sorry that we could not bring you more of it. Thank you for understanding.

[h2]About Convenience Controls[/h2]

Here are some useful operation tips to improve your playing experience.

[h3]・Convenient movement[/h3]
[Mouse] Click where you want to move on the mini-map: teleportation
[Controller] LT button + left stick: move with double speed

[h3]・When you want to return to the main screen immediately while operating in a menu:[/h3]
[Mouse] Press and hold the right mouse button.
[Keyboard] Press and hold the Esc key.
[Controller] Press and hold the B button.
[Mouse/Touch control] Press and hold the Back button at the top left of the game screen.

[h3]・Display of two or three rows of the main menu:[/h3]
[Mouse Touch control] Drag/swipe the icon menu to the left.
[Keyboard/Controller] Move the cursor to the menu and press the left key/button.

[h3]・Hide UI in the main screen:[/h3]
[Mouse] Right click + wheel button
[Keyboard] BackSpace key
[Controller] Back button

[h3]・Fast forward and rewind conversations:[/h3]
[Mouse/Touch control] Click the fast forward and rewind buttons on the lower left
[Controller] RT button, LT button

[h3]・Open "Help" for basic operations and detailed instructions:[/h3]
[mouse/touch] Click on the book icon in the upper right corner of the game screen
[Controller] Menu button
[Keyboard] H key

i.e. "Help" Operation Explanation > Mouse & Keyboard

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386106/9c6f68e0d351c498ea65e4bb311232c3fa1b358c.png[/img]
